title: 소감 말하기: 끝나서 아쉬워요, 그래도 보람 있었어요
objective: By the end, you can say in one short sentence how you feel when something ends. You will use words like 아쉽다, 섭섭하다, 보람, and 기쁘다.
summary: Learn ten words for saying how you feel after a class, trip, job, or goodbye.

task.title: Use the feeling words
task.line: Read each short situation, then choose or write the word that fits.

words.meaning: your thoughts and feelings about an experience (often asked after it ends)
words.example: 한국어 수업을 마친 소감을 말해 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Please tell us how you feel now that the Korean class is over.

words.meaning: to feel; to realize something from an experience
words.example: 봉사 활동을 하면서 많은 것을 느꼈어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I felt and realized many things while doing volunteer work.

words.meaning: to feel sorry that something is over or did not happen; to wish it were different
words.exampleMeaning: It's already the last class, so I'm sorry it's ending.

words.meaning: the good feeling that your hard work was worth it (보람이 있다, 보람을 느끼다)
words.example: 아이들을 가르치는 일은 힘들지만 보람이 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Teaching children is hard, but it's rewarding.

words.meaning: to feel sad because someone is leaving or you are parting
words.example: 친구가 다음 주에 고향에 돌아가요. 그래서 섭섭해요.
words.exampleMeaning: My friend is going back home next week, so I'm sad to see them go.

words.meaning: to feel happy and glad about something good
words.exampleMeaning: I gave a presentation in Korean by myself, and I felt happy.

words.meaning: to stay in your memory; to be memorable
words.exampleMeaning: The trip to Jeju Island is the one I remember most.

words.meaning: an experience (something you did or lived through)
words.example: 한국 회사에서 일한 것은 좋은 경험이었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Working at a Korean company was a good experience.

words.meaning: being deeply moved or touched (감동을 받다)
words.exampleMeaning: I was moved by my teacher's words at the graduation ceremony.

words.meaning: to finish (a course, a job, a program)
words.exampleMeaning: I finally finished the six-month training program.

exercises: Choose the right word: 옆집 언니가 다음 주에 이사를 가요. 정말 (섭섭해요 / 기뻐요).
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 매일 할머니 식사를 도와 드려요. 일이 힘들어도 도움이 됐다는 ____을 느껴요.
Choose 아쉬워요 or 기뻐요 for each situation: ① 콘서트 표를 못 샀어요. ② 처음으로 김치를 직접 만들었어요. ③ 휴가가 하루밖에 안 남았어요.
Fill in each blank with 소감, 경험, or 기억 (use each once): ① 대회에서 1등을 한 ____이 어때요? ② 이번 여름에 농장에서 일하는 ____을 했어요. ③ 그 영화의 마지막 장면이 오래 ____에 남았어요.
Fill in each blank with 감동, 마치다, or 느끼다 in the right form: ① 배우들의 노래가 정말 아름다워서 ____을 받았어요. ② 오늘 일을 일찍 ____ 영화를 봤어요. ③ 그 사람의 편지에서 따뜻한 마음을 ____.
answers: ① 아쉬워요 ② 기뻐요 ③ 아쉬워요
① 소감 ② 경험 ③ 기억
① 감동 ② 마쳐서 (마치고) ③ 느꼈어요
